\int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} e ^ {- 2 t} u (t) e ^ {- s t} d t = \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} e ^ {- (s + 2) t} d t = - \left. \frac {e ^ {- (s + 2) t}}{s + 2} \right| _ {0} ^ {\infty} = 0 + \frac {1}{s + 2} = \frac {1}{s + 2}

\begin{array}{r l} & {\int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} [ e ^ {- 2 t} u (t) + e ^ {3 t} u (- t) ] \cdot e ^ {- s t} d t} \\ & {= \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} e ^ {- 2 t} u (t) \cdot e ^ {- s t} d t + \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} e ^ {3 t} u (- t) \cdot e ^ {- s t} d t} \\ & {= \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} e ^ {- (s + 2) t} d t + \int_ {- \infty} ^ {0} e ^ {- (s - 3) t} d t} \\ & {= \frac {e ^ {- (s + 2) t}}{- (s + 2)} \bigg | _ {0} ^ {\infty} + \frac {e ^ {- (s - 3) t}}{- (s - 3)} \bigg | _ {- \infty} ^ {0} = \frac {- 5}{s ^ {2} - s - 6}} \end{array}

#性质名称时间函数f(t)复频域函数F(s)
1线性C_1f_1(t)+C_2f_2(t)C_1F_1(s)+C_2F_2(s)
2时移f(t-t_0)u(t-t_0), t_0>0F(s)e^{-st_0}, t_0>0
3尺度变换f(at), a>0\frac{1}{a}F\left(\frac{s}{a}\right)
4频移f(t)e^{-s_0t}, s_0为复常数F(s+s_0), s_0为复常数
5时间微分\frac{df(t)}{dt}sF(s)-f(0_-)
\frac{df^n(t)}{dt^n}s^nF(s)-\sum_{r=0}^{n-1}s^{n-r-1}f^{(r)}(0_-)
6时间积分\int_{-\infty}^t f(\tau)d\tau\frac{F(s)}{s}+\frac{f^{-1}(0_-)}{s}
7时域卷积定理f_1(t)*f_2(t)F_1(s)\cdot F_2(s)
8复频域卷积定理f_1(t)\cdot f_2(t)\frac{1}{2\pi j}F_1(s)*F_2(s)
9复频域微分性t^n f(t)(-1)^n\frac{d^nF(s)}{ds^n}
10复频域积分性\frac{f(t)}{t}\int_s^\infty F(\eta)d\eta
11初值定理F(s)是真分式\lim_{t\to 0_+}f(t)=f(0_+) = \lim_{s\to \infty}sF(s)
F(s)是假分式F(s)\xrightarrow{\text{长除法}}多项式+F_1(s)真分式\lim_{t\to 0_+}f(t)=f(0_+) = \lim_{s\to \infty}sF_1(s)
12终值定理f(\infty)=\lim_{s\to 0}sF(s), s=0在收敛域内。即终值存在,才能用终值定理
